base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-19a7ce5f.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if abs(c - center) == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif abs(c - center) < r and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path.read_text())
